description: Outline of one act: one row per article in legal order (2, 2-bis, 5, 10), with the rubrica, the number of commi and the total number of articles of the act. Parameters: urn (the act URN without the article part, e.g. urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212), limit (1..200, default 50), offset (default 0). An unknown act gives no rows. Example: {"urn": "urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212", "limit": 20}.
